description: The benchmark borrow and supply rate for lending on Stacks, read from lending contract state. Use this to judge whether a lending offer is good: borrowing above the SBOR borrow rate means paying more than the market, supplying below the supply rate means earning less. Returns every currency index unless one is named. Always read the freshness line first.

index.description: Currency index, or BTC-COLLATERAL-USDC for borrowing USDC against bitcoin on Base and Ethereum. Omit for all of them.

name: get_rate
title: Get the current SBOR fixing
